messages:
Sam T.: Drafting the public release notes for v0.10.0. Major items: default quantization profiles, smarter routing fallbacks, and a minor reranker score variance in some locales. Need :eyes: on snippets and translations before we publish.
Priya N.: I'll proofread the English copy and handle the "What changed" bullets. Can someone confirm the exact console dashboard link for rollout metrics?
Leo H.: Console rollout dashboard is https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts (we should link to /rollouts/v0.10.0 specifically). I'll paste the permalink when the rollout job finishes.
Carmen R.: Quick note on translations: FR and DE teams flagged a couple of long strings that overflow our side nav. Might need shorter headings for the migrating-caching section. I'll add suggested headings in the translation PR.
Sam T.: Good catch Carmen. Keep the public notes concise; longer explanations go to the migration guide. Also include a tiny code example for disabling the new default quantization for Node and Python under "How to opt-out".
Leo H.: Draft Node opt-out snippet (one line):
```js
const client = new Redwood.Client(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, { quantization: { profile: 'legacy' } });
```
And Python:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], quantization_profile='legacy')
```
Feel free to shorten.
Priya N.: Those look fine, I'll trim wording around them. Small copy change request: change header from "Behavior changes" to "Behavioral changes" for consistency in the changelog.
Sam T.: Done. Also adding a one-line Known issue: "Reranker scores may vary by small margins in non-en locales; results remain within tolerance. We're investigating locale-specific tokenization differences." Add :bug: emoji.
Carmen R.: I've opened PR #912 to shorten headings and fix nav overflow. Also added a comment suggesting alternate phrasing for the migration anchor.
DocsBot: PR #912 opened by Carmen R. 5 "fix(i18n): shorten headings for caching migration". CI: queued.
Priya N.: PR #915 contains the release notes draft and the opt-out snippets. Please review for accuracy.
DocsBot: PR #915 opened by Sam T. 5 "docs(relnotes): v0.10.0 draft with opt-out snippets". CI: checks passed.
Leo H.: CI passed on #915. Permalink to rollout job pending; will post once available.
TranslatorBot: New translation tasks created for keys: [relnotes.v0.10.what_changed, relnotes.v0.10.known_issue.reranker]. Assigned FR/DE/ES.
Carmen R.: Quick note: for the public known issue we should avoid implementation detail (no mention of quantization internals). Keep it user-facing.
Sam T.: Agreed. PR #915 updated to remove internal wording. Also added a "How to roll back for Dedicated" blurb: set routing.policy to previous value and reuse previous quantization_profile. Short example included.
Leo H.: Here's the rollout permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/v0.10.0?env=prod . I'll add it to PR #915.
Priya N.: I ran a quick snippet test in a minimal app and both opt-out examples work as expected. One tiny nit: change "opt-out" -> "opt out" (two words) across the doc.
Sam T.: Fixed wording. Final ask: can someone run the link sweep for any outdated /docs/kb/ references? I think we moved a lot to /docs/optimize last quarter.
Carmen R.: I'll sweep links and open PR #918 for redirects and anchor additions (prefix-cache anchor + redirect for /docs/kb/caching).
DocsBot: PR #918 opened by Carmen R. 5 "chore(docs): redirects and anchors for caching pages". CI: pending.
TranslatorBot: FR translation for relnotes v0.10 uploaded to review by Carmen R.
Leo H.: All green from engineering side. If translations look ok and #918 fixes the redirects, I'm fine publishing tomorrow at 09:00 PT.
Sam T.: Great. I'll schedule the publish and update the internal changelog with the tracker link for the reranker investigation. Thanks everyone. If any last-minute snippet or link issues surface, drop them here before 08:30 PT. :rocket:
